notes.title: 🐱 Meow meow, it's release time !
notes.notes:
Happy can't wait to see you again so you can take good care of him !
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627511/cbbd1a826ecee21e5f426affd8ed3ca5561ac3ce.png"]

Happy Pet is finally available to everyone. After a beta testing phase, the game is ready for public release. You'll be able to :

Feed

Wash

Chat

Play

Sleep

... with Happy !



But be careful, follow his desires ! Don’t try to force him if he’s not in the mood… you might regret it.



Take care of your new virtual pet, increase your affection score, and become the most important person in his world.


Adopt Happy right here :
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753250/Happy_Pet/"][/dynamiclink]😻😻😻
